highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15 and GPU rendering corrections.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named script constants without changing its struct-based Script API. GPU fixes address reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clipping and displacement precision; the shared hash-code polyfill now seeds its per-process randomness from the operating system.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. The first preview uses HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz 14.4.0; Preview 2 upgrades the engine to HarfBuzz 15.0.0.

Adds 30 Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while retaining all existing fields and values. The Script struct keeps its parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup; no public managed member is removed.

Corrects reflected zero-length square hairline caps and rounds text-atlas indices before sampler selection. Graphite counts pending clips before flushing and logs and skips draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh pass, preventing pass-capacity overflow.

Adds a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary drivers from 42 up to, but not including, 56. Native synchronous submission now includes fence-wait failure in its result without changing asynchronous submission; GRContext.Submit remains void with no new managed result.

Uses fp32 displacement scale and offset arithmetic to match filter-bounds calculations, avoiding half-precision rounding differences in sample positions. Color samples and channel selectors retain half precision.

The shared hash-code polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp uses RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random for its per-process seed. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash-code polyfill's seed with OS-generated randomness and added analyzer safeguards against unjustified System.Random use in shipped code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Introduces the Skia m158 engine without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Upgrades HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants. GPU fixes correct reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17: Improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait-result handling, without adding a managed submission result. The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated per-process randomness while retaining within-process stability.

harfbuzz_summary: Upgrades native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script fields, values and struct-based operations remain available; removing the unused internal deprecated font-face setter import removes no public managed API.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: SkiaSharp's managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages advance to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.

v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.headline: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling.
v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.body: The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated randomness while remaining stable within a process. Managed API signatures are unchanged.
